description.value: Cloverdale Arena is a City of Surrey municipal recreation facility in the Cloverdale neighbourhood offering both ice and dry-floor programming to the public. It is a community-oriented arena operated by Surrey Parks & Recreation, primarily serving local residents with drop-in and registered sport programs. Touring cyclists passing through the area might find it a recognizable civic landmark, though it is not cycling-focused.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The City of Surrey website confirms the facility name, address (6090 176 Street, Surrey, BC V3S 4E7), and phone (604-502-6410) exactly match OSM tags. The page describes Cloverdale Arena as a municipal ice and dry-floor sports facility with drop-in programs, but contains no mention of cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, showers, café, vending, or water refill stations, so all amenity fields default to null. The page carries a temporary notice of closure due to a power outage alongside a general 'Cloverdale Arena is open' status, indicating the closure is transient rather than permanent.
concerns: Website contains a temporary alert stating 'Cloverdale Arena is currently closed due to a power outage' alongside the general open status; the closure appears transient but should be monitored.
Category assigned as 'Attractions' in OSM does not accurately reflect this facility's nature as a municipal sports/recreation centre; consider re-categorising.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cloverdale Arena is a legitimate, operating municipal sports facility, but it is a general-public ice and dry-floor arena with no confirmed cycling-specific amenities; it does not clearly serve the needs of a touring cyclist and its fit as a WWC 'Attraction' is weak without further evidence of cyclist-relevant services.

provenance.category_correction_reason: The facility is a municipal ice arena and sports centre (OSM: leisure=sports_centre), which does not align with a cycling tourism Attractions category; a Recreation Facilities category would be more accurate.
